content.text:
A waived fee no longer counts as owed, so a member whose fees were waived is no longer refused at checkout for owing fees. Their account summary no longer shows the waived amount either. All 61 tests pass: the 60 existing ones plus one new one.

**Cause:** `outstandingBalance` in `lib/fees/balance.js` only skipped fees marked `paid`. `waiveFee` records a waiver by setting `waivedReason` and leaves `paid` false, so waived fees were still added to the balance. Both the checkout eligibility check and the member summary route use that function.

**Fix:** the function now skips any fee that is paid or has a `waivedReason`, so both places are fixed by the one change.

I added a test, "a waived fee is not owed", in `test/fees.test.js`. It waives one of two fees and expects the balance to be just the other fee.

My first attempt to add that test through a shell command was blocked by the permission check, so I added it with the edit tool instead. I also saved the fix to the repo's memory (kronomind) as a note on `outstandingBalance`.
